goal: Add a Settings scene with volume sliders per audio bus, key remap, and accessibility toggles (relaxed-rhythm, high-contrast, audio-only cues). Reads + writes a `SettingsV1` shape that the SaveV1 store can persist. Implements the Scene interface and routes back to the title via the existing SceneRouter contract (a new 'settings' event variant).
constraints: `SettingsV1` (in settings-types.ts) extends the placeholder Phase-1 type: add `relaxedRhythm: boolean`, `highContrast: boolean`, `audioOnlyCues: boolean`. Keep existing `musicVolume: number; sfxVolume: number`. Append-only.

`SettingsScene` constructor: `{ renderer, input, audio: AudioManager, settings: SettingsV1, onEvent: (event: 'cancel' | 'apply', updated?: SettingsV1) => void }`. The scene mutates a draft copy of `settings`; on `apply` it surfaces the updated copy through `onEvent`.

UI: a vertical list of rows — Music Volume slider, SFX Volume slider, Relaxed Rhythm toggle, High Contrast toggle, Audio-Only Cues toggle, plus an 'Apply' and 'Back' row. Up/Down navigates rows; Left/Right adjusts sliders (5% step) and flips toggles; Confirm on Apply emits 'apply'; Confirm on Back or Cancel emits 'cancel'.

Live binding: while a slider row is focused, adjusting it ALSO calls `audio.setBusVolume('music' | 'sfx-attack' | 'sfx-defense' | 'sfx-world' | 'ui' | 'voice', value / 100)` so the change is audible before Apply. (Music slider drives 'music' bus; SFX slider drives the four sfx-* buses + 'voice' + 'ui'.)

Add `'settings'` to the RouterEvent type union in `src/scenes/scene-router.ts` (APPEND-ONLY edit). Add transitions: `title --settings--> settings`, `settings --cancel--> title`, `settings --apply--> title`.
Tests use the stubbed ctx pattern; mock InputManager with a queued press API; mock AudioManager (just verify setBusVolume is called with the expected args).
Strict TS; integer-pixel positioning; underscored unused params.
acceptance: Test: scene renders 7 rows by default (5 settings + Apply + Back).
Test: Down-Down navigates from Music to Relaxed Rhythm row.
Test: Left on a slider row decreases value by 5%; Right increases by 5%; clamped to [0, 100].
Test: Right on a toggle row flips bool.
Test: Confirm on Apply emits 'apply' with the updated SettingsV1.
Test: SceneRouter transitions title -> settings on `transition('settings')`, settings -> title on apply or cancel.
≥85% coverage on settings-scene.ts; 100% on settings-types.ts; existing scene-router tests still pass after the union widening.
